briefing.headline: Nvidia beat expectations on its Q3 results and its stock rose, but the company is still dealing with Jensen Huang's resignation and the board's investigation.

points.text: Nvidia's Q3 earnings beat expectations and the stock rose nearly 4%. Neoclouds also surged.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia reported a beat-and-raise quarter. JPMorgan's team says more near-term volatility is likely.
points.label: reported

points.text: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO. He says he will cooperate with the board's investigation into his relationship with an alleged Chinese intelligence-linked executive.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia's board chair says the board does not intend to rehire Huang as CEO.
points.label: reported

points.text: Anthropic's IPO may price above its $70 to $78 range. Its shares are now in focus for AI investors.
